annotations.title: Start a checkout for them to pay

description: Start a checkout for the person you act for: an item from get_pricing for one of their listings (a placement needs the listing approved first). Returns checkoutUrl, the payment page: give it to the person to pay — you never pay, and nothing is charged until they do. We also email them the link. Holds a week's spot while they pay. Needs billing:checkout.

coupon.description: A coupon code the person gave you. Optional.

week.description: For an item bought by the week: the week it starts (week-46-2026). Omit for the first open one.

weeks.description: For an item bought by the week: how many weeks it runs (1, 2 or 4).

name: start_checkout

checkoutUrl.description: The payment page: give it to the person to pay.

payUrl.description: Our page that opens a fresh checkout for it.
